items.overview: During the summer of 1955, the beautiful and rebellious Isabella leaves her husband and takes their daughter Alissa  to her mother's house in Jerusalem.  There she meets Richard, an English business man on a trip and falls in love with him against her mother's wishes while using Alissa as an alibi.  Alissa, torn between her mother and grandmother, begins to discover old painful secrets in her family are preventing her mother from ever being truly happy.  As the truth slowly comes to light, it threatens to destroy everything they've built and known...
items.title: Isabella- Beer Sheva

items.overview: A satire of the well-known, "The Notebook" (2004).
items.title: The Notebook: reimagined

items.overview: Prom night is just around the corner at Roarville Academy, and 17-year-old Sidney Rivers isn't exactly thrilled about going. But with his enthusiastic best friend Harvey Brooks determined to make it a night to remember, and a new girl in town catching Sidney's attention, things might just get interesting!
items.title: Sidney Rivers: Rebel Heart

items.overview: A 45-year-old corporate worker befriends a group of young skaters and secretly begins learning to skateboard during his lunch breaks. When doubt and judgment creep in, he must decide whether to abandon the joy he’s found or embrace the risk of starting over.
items.title: Don’t Bail

items.overview: Q, a 21-year-old filmmaker caught between ambition and self-doubt, isolates himself to finish a short film he hopes will change his life. But when his college roommate Alonso throws a party, the night spirals into tension, confrontation, and a moment of reckoning that forces Q to face what’s really holding him back. Only 21 is a grounded, emotional portrait of creative pressure, growing up, and finding the courage to take the first real step toward your dreams.
items.title: Only 21

items.overview: A horror stop-motion animation film exploring queer desire and emancipation after the death of Michelle's abusive and homophobic mother.
items.title: Cabbageworm

items.overview: Together since high school, Alexandre and Jordan travel to the United States to fulfill their dream of becoming fathers through surrogacy, which is illegal in France. Their meeting with Nicole, who agrees to carry their child, ushers in a period of hope and anticipation, as well as doubts and trust to be built. Through appointments, decisions to be made, and the upheavals of daily life, each of them gradually finds their place in this journey that binds them together forever.
items.title: Papas

items.overview: They've shared blood, money, and years of friendship. They know each other's habits, their weaknesses, their tells.  But someone at the table has been playing a different game all along...
items.title: RaTaTaTurn

items.overview: A young woman, coming to terms with the loss of her boyfriend, receives a letter in the post with a USB containing videos of him.
items.title: The Memory of You

items.overview: For generations, a family has had a human skull in their home. They journey through historical, ethical, spiritual and scientific perspectives to try to understand who this individual was and how to properly care for their remains.
items.title: Jolly

items.overview: 12 Scenes. 20 Characters.
items.title: Domestics

items.original_title: NON È LA FINE DEL MONDO
items.title: NON È LA FINE DEL MONDO

items.overview: Nine voices from different generations trace the history of wingsuit flying, from the invention of the suit to the preparation for a jump and the desire to fly.
items.title: Birdlife

items.overview: An American expat’s first-day commute on Berlin’s Ringbahn becomes a loop that will not stop. Its enforcers demand a fare; his ticket and credentials mean nothing. The machine wants the one thing he refuses to give.
items.title: Ringatory

items.overview: In a remote village, a determined teenage boy named Asho makes a brave decision and takes a two-year-old girl named Asma to another village so her arrival may bring blessing. On the way, an unexpected event forces Asho to choose between returning Asma and following his own need.
items.title: Wolf's Hair

items.overview: A documentary set in Gatineau, Québec, following a group of teenage friends who gather for an underground fight club in a garage. Through an evening of boxing matches, the film explores the dynamics of friendship, rivalry and camaraderie among the group.
items.title: No Cheap Shots

items.overview: In a remote village, a determined teenage boy named Asho makes a brave decision and takes a two-year-old girl named Asma to another village so her arrival may bring blessing. On the way, an unexpected event forces Asho to choose between returning Asma and following his own need.
items.title: Wolf's Hair

items.overview: A documentary set in Gatineau, Québec, following a group of teenage friends who gather for an underground fight club in a garage. Through an evening of boxing matches, the film explores the dynamics of friendship, rivalry and camaraderie among the group.
items.title: No Cheap Shots

items.overview: It’s a 100-minute drama. We’re not sharing the title or synopsis yet.
items.title: KIRAC 32

items.overview: Herbert, a middle-aged investment banker, secretly spends his lunch breaks learning to skateboard after a group of local skaters take him in. However, when a coworker finds out, he must decide what scares him more: judgment or regret.
items.title: Don’t Bail

items.overview: Join Dan and many other friendly faces from across Austin, TX, as they perform multiple pain-inducing stunts and gags  to commemorate Dan's 26th birthday including; The Uni-Bastard, The Blind Butt Tattoo, and Baby Oil Couch Surfing.
items.title: danass

items.overview: An ordinary night turns into a living nightmare when a 14-year-old boy hears a sharp tap on his bedroom window.  Outside in the freezing air stands a breathless stranger, desperately running from the police. With sirens wailing in the distance, a terrifying standoff begins through the glass. Safe inside but completely isolated, the boy faces an impossible, split-second choice that will instantly shatter the security of his home.
items.title: Who Are You?

items.overview: When an unexpected event shatters a 10-year-old girl’s mental state, her hyper-precise daily ritual of cooking sour soup for her sick mother completely breaks down, leaving her with a ruined recipe she can no longer fix.
items.title: Sinigang na Tuyo (Dried Pork Stew)

items.overview: A young Deaf artist struggling to connect with her mother finds an unexpected bridge through friendship, art, and Filipino Sign Language, forcing her to confront their widening distance.
items.title: Patlang (Gap)

items.overview: Max, a blind Zapotec accordion player, and Sam, a British violinist who speaks "poquito" Spanish, meet on the streets of Oaxaca City. There a friendship is born that transcends language, culture, music, and the senses.
items.title: Zapocelta

items.original_title: Antisémitisme, une haine toujours en mouvements
items.title: Antisémitisme, une haine toujours en mouvements

items.overview: The film bears a joint Egyptian-German character, and through its title and artistic journey, it provides a space to celebrate one of the most prominent figures of Arab music, composer Mohamed Abdel Wahab, and to explore his musical legacy and influence, with the participation of Fatma Said, who is considered one of the most prominent Egyptian voices in the world of opera and classical singing globally blending cinematic and musical language.
items.title: Fatma Said and the Abdelwahab Plan

items.overview: A theatre critic interviews the first AI to have an original play open on Broadway.
items.title: _Preview_

items.overview: A short film produced by the 2nd Unit Class at SZFE.
items.title: Exit

items.overview: Inspired by real events where the heroic act of pedestrians saved a man from his cousin, who attacked him with a knife attack due to an argument about inheritance.
items.title: Unspoken Worlds

items.overview: Augusta Street, São Paulo, near future. Amid neon and underpaid gigs claimed by robots and cyborgs, a lonely android wanders in search of a pleasure it may never have been programmed to feel.
items.title: Augusta 2049: A Street Named Sin

items.overview: A lonely British-Chinese girl is excited to finally make a new friend when her new neighbours move in, but soon comes to realise that the world is never so simple…
items.title: Chilli Chong Carne

items.overview: A group of Jewish Ramblers from Manchester find solace, friendship and tranquility in the spectacular hills around the city.
items.title: Rambling

items.original_title: Rachel Jones Needs a Boyfriend Not a Bat-Mitzvah
items.overview: Follows a young Welsh Jewish girl on her quest for a boyfriend, while also trying to prepare for her upcoming Bat Mitzvah.
items.title: Rachel Jones Needs a Boyfriend Not a Bat-Mitzvah

items.overview: What if life gave you a second chance? The sea might grant you a second life, but it doesn’t teach you what to do with it.  After surviving a shipwreck in the middle of the Atlantic as a young sailor, a man carries an impossible question for decades: what should he do with the time he was never meant to have?  Through memories, silences, and a relationship shaped by the sea, *Borrowed Time* is an intimate reflection on the fragility of existence, the weight of memory, and the human need to find meaning in second chances.
items.title: Tiempo Prestado

items.overview: As he is about to leave Viña del Mar, his hometown, Javier begins filming gardens without quite knowing what he is looking for. For eight years, each time he returns, he explores trees, plants, and landscapes, composing a visual essay in which avocado trees, palm trees, and roses coexist with fairy tales, colonial ghosts, and the class conflicts that run through the heart of his own family.
items.title: Ciudad Jardín

items.overview: While trying to explain to her seven-year-old son what it was like to grow up in Chile under the civil-military dictatorship, a mother is confronted with her own memories and the need to revisit her past.  After almost twenty years living in Spain, she decides to find women who, like her, were born and spent their early years under the Chilean dictatorship. Andrea, Claudia, Alejandra, Daniela, Victoria and Sol gather in a house to share their experiences and explore how that early experience — often fragmented or beyond conscious memory — has left marks that remain present in their lives.  In this encounter, the personal and the political intertwine, giving rise to a collective reflection on memory, identity, and the ways in which the past transforms and endures from one generation to another.
items.title: Not All The Girls

items.overview: Different ages, situations and languages converge seemingly at random on the same mat: one person practices prenatal exercises, another takes contortion lessons, and another prays with disciplined devotion.  Gradually, through drawings, glances, flowers and somersaults, gestures and connections begin to emerge, hinting at a bond between them. Around the mat, a slow process of bodily self-deformation unfolds, where destruction and creation become indistinguishable, and care and pain intertwine.
items.title: (de)forma

items.overview: Two realities slowly align as Fang's chaos magic targeting pop star Eileen Rye triggers an unforeseen change. Fang seeks meaning in the mysterious thread they've pulled, both entering a world where memories, dreams, and digital encounters merge.
items.title: Octarine

items.original_title: The Best Justice System in the World
items.overview: A humorous look at the not-so-funny ways the government and corporations strip us of our right to a jury trial
items.title: The Best Justice System in the World

items.overview: A junior footballer navigates the brutal hierarchy of a 1988 professional football club steeped in a culture of systemic bullying . His growing unease culminates in a hesitant act of defiance sparking a brutal backlash, turning the violence directly onto him.
items.title: The Boot Room

items.overview: The architect of a virtual world called Presence is interviewed about its profound capabilities – it can trigger lucidity in Alzheimer's patients. Meanwhile, inside Presence, a daughter tries to reconnect with her mother, an Alzheimer's sufferer, and bring her back to the physical world.
items.title: The Phenomenon of Presence

items.overview: Mizoram unfolds as a land where mist-covered hills, close-knit tribes, and an enduring spirit of community shape every aspect of life. This documentary journeys into the heart of Mizo society, exploring the guiding ethos of tlawmngaihna—the tradition of selflessness, courage, discipline, and service to others.
items.title: Ethos of Mizoram

items.overview: In a dark factory, a bullying worker pushes his crew of robots harder and harder. They observe. They learn. And eventually, they act. The machines are learning, but what are we teaching them?
items.title: Machines Learning

items.overview: Clotaire Poirier is not your typical chef. A globetrotter and polyglot, he rose to prominence with French audiences as a finalist on "Top Chef", embodying a new generation of cooks for whom performance no longer comes at the expense of people.
items.title: Don't Call Me Chef

items.overview: A film about a mind-numbing job, delicious food, absurd numbers, big dreams, death, and toast.
items.title: The Toast Trip

items.overview: May and Sultan struggle to live within a home consumed by silence after a devastating loss alters their relationship forever. While Sultan clings to hope and the possibility of moving forward, May endures relentless physical pain and carries a secret she cannot bring herself to reveal. As the distance between them grows, old suspicions resurface, and the burden she bears begins to fracture the fragile foundation of their marriage.
items.title: What We Carry

items.overview: Edgar draws dancers in Amsterdam. Everyone knows him.
items.title: The One Who Draws Dance

items.overview: A forty-year-old woman floats in a relationship bubble until she realizes it is too late.
items.title: Bubbles

items.overview: A young girl watches an old dog. Taking the dog on a walk, a rough encounter with a bully has dire consequences.
items.title: Fido

items.overview: Thian 'Tarzan' de Vries is a young kickboxing sensation from the Netherlands who is rapidly conquering the international fight scene. Behind his invincible image, however, lies a turbulent past marked by addiction, crime, and time spent in youth detention. Kickboxing became both his escape and his salvation. As Thian rises through the ranks toward global recognition, an unease grows beneath the surface: can he keep control when the system that protects him begins to crack?
items.title: Knocked Cold

items.overview: Two former coworkers lose their insurance and decide couples therapy is a budget-friendly option
items.title: Friends With Benefits

items.overview: Ignored by history for 40 years, the Oversteegen sisters' true story inspires "Murderers" (1941-1990). Two teenage girls lure a Nazi to his death. Echoing the psychological trauma of war, emigration, and today's chilling winds of fascism, the film asks: what is the true price of murder for a righteous cause, and what remains of our humanity after we are forced to cross the ultimate line?
items.title: Murderers

items.overview: In a wasteland of rubble and ruin, J. Doe—a Black Patient Zero—navigates the wreckage of a nation haunted by its own reflection. Pursued by histories of violence, erasure, and resistance, he confronts the ghosts of an unfinished reckoning. Blurring archive and hallucination, Disordered is a visual requiem—part ritual, part rupture—that confronts the consequences of a soul that cannot forget, yet refuses to remember its past.
items.title: D!SoRd3rEd

items.overview: A very important company audit is jeopardized when a staff member reveals the fates of his coworkers' eternal souls.
items.title: The Audit

items.overview: At 89, Joseph Ullmann keeps the tradition of his grandfather’s Budapest antique jewellery business alive. In today’s Hatton Garden, he and his shop are the last of their kind.
items.title: The Last Jewel

items.overview: A fairy tale about an animated film. The life of this film suddenly takes a cursed turn. The consequences of this change become apparent
items.title: Frame Story

items.overview: The quest for a lost cyberpunk book written in the 1990s by Pepe Rojo, rumored to be a prophetic work of its time. After uncovering new leads, an obsessed young man embarks on a journey across northern Mexico to track down the remaining fragments and fuel his own delusion.
items.title: Al Tiempo le da Hipo

items.overview: As a strange red lichen spreads across the countryside, Geryon confronts the emergence of sexual desire and an animal metamorphosis that drives him to flee into the mountains.
items.title: Grace Comes Crashing

items.overview: On her birthday, Kiran, an overworked mother, is faced with a fantastical possibility when her yesteryear Bollywood crush arrives at her door, with just one request - to marry her.
items.title: Dream Girl

items.overview: Egos, money and science intersect in this modern American parable that follows the king of the dinosaurs and those who unearth its remains. Paleontologist Dr. Thomas Carr hopes his latest find, a juvenile T. rex, can keep his crucial research alive as he navigates the crumbling world of academia and relentless funding pressure. Meanwhile, commercial fossil hunter Alan Detrich leads multimillion-dollar dinosaur auctions and teams up with a Kansas museum to show off a T. rex specimen so rare it could change the face of prehistory. As these two titans of paleontology clash, we are confronted with two paths for the future of science: raw capitalism or putting collective knowledge before the pursuit of profit.
items.title: The New Extinction

items.overview: Linda is a widow raising her seven-year-old son alone. The boy suffers from xeroderma pigmentosum, a rare genetic disorder. He will suffer severe damage once exposed to sunlight and has to stay in the shadows for most of his life. To protect her son, Linda builds layers of barriers to shut out the outside world. As time goes by, the mother gradually realises that overprotection will only deprive her child of the right to experience life.
items.title: To The Sun and Beyond

items.overview: During their holiday, two little girls help Janet, a heartbroken English traveller—unaware that this encounter will jeopardise their own family
items.title: Janet's Island

items.overview: Dustin and Dibz are best pals; they survived their senior year of college, and their future looks bright. They share an apartment, an internet series, and the dream of finding their place in an uncertain landscape, navigating male fragility and identity crisis. The challenges of messy adult manhood are fully open to them.
items.title: Pop Pop

items.overview: In a remote village, two rival families – one privileged Hindu, the other a struggling Muslim family – are trapped in an endless cycle of feuds. A young man dreaming of TikTok fame and a woman yearning to escape patriarchy fall in love. When an inheritance dispute erupts, their relationship is caught between greed, betrayal, and a conflict that threatens to turn blood against blood.
items.title: Kidney

items.overview: Guided by a prophetic dream, Gift travels through Niger, Algeria, and Tunisia on her way to Europe. This poetic film follows her struggle to stand on her own two feet and shows the personal cost of her dangerous search for a better life.
items.title: You Don't Die Two Times

items.overview: In a chalet in the Ukrainian mountains, four women attend therapy sessions to recover from their very different, deeply traumatic experiences of the war. They each try, in their own way, to resume their former lives.
items.title: Women and War

items.overview: Following the final voyage of the enormous, ageing cruise ship Royal Splendor through the Three Gorges on the Yangtze, this experimental film explores the river as a living repository of memory.
items.title: Waves of Time

items.overview: Four years in the life of Zaira, an elderly woman living in the marshlands of Iraq. Against all odds, she clings to her life close to nature. A poetic and moving testament to resilience and perseverance.
items.title: She Was Not Alone

items.overview: Long, observational shots of people and animals going about their activities in the landscape surrounding a gigantic, ever-growing landfill site prompt reflection on the traces we as humans leave behind on our planet.
items.title: Radiant Mountain

items.overview: As the granddaughter of a Roma king, ten-year-old Nicoleta seems destined for a fairy-tale life. She will marry young and live in a palace. But looking at her grandmother, mother, and aunt, she also sees a traditional life constrained by patriarchy.
items.title: A Modern Roma Fairytale

items.overview: In a small square in Mexico City, Haitian migrants live in a makeshift tent camp. This observational film follows three women whose daily life finds its own rhythm, despite the instability.
items.title: Here Where the Fire Burns

items.overview: A major earthquake will occur along the San Andreas Fault in California sometime—that much is certain. But when? A free-associative road trip with mineral meditations about life on the edge, where tectonic plates collide.
items.title: Drop! Cover! Hold On!

items.overview: Ruslan Fedotov follows the course of the Dnieper to observe the lives of young people in Russia and Belarus, tracing how collective memory enters the lives and imagination of youth.
items.title: Down the River

items.overview: A portrait of painter Peter Dumas, the father of photographer and filmmaker Charlotte Dumas, is interwoven with observations of her daughter Ivy as she grows up. The creative process connects their lives.
items.title: The Brush in Your Hand

items.overview: In Berlin, a diverse coalition of activists joins forces to speak out against the violence in Gaza and the German government’s support for it. Faced with arrests, possible deportations, and strict restrictions on protests, the activists seek ways to continue their struggle. In this climate, they start rehearsing a stage adaptation of a 1970s queer book entitled The Faggots and Their Friends Between Revolutions. This hybrid and experimental film shifts between rehearsals of the play and the everyday reality of activism. Passages from the play—about power structures, exclusion, and solidarity—are interwoven with their ongoing protests and their sometimes sympathetic, sometimes confrontational conversations with the press. Juxtaposed, the intensity of protest and the creative freedom of theater sharpen the focus on what it means to be an activist—and the toll it takes on those involved.
items.title: Between Revolutions

items.title: Down the River

items.overview: A recent grad spends her summer avoiding responsibility in an empty apartment, bumming around her small, southern college town with the maintenance man.
items.title: Baby Angel

items.overview: This film is a coming-of-age short drama set against the isolated, moody landscapes of Cornwall, England. It follows two young brothers who find themselves completely alone after their estranged father vanishes. Armed with only a few belongings, they wander through the backwaters and costal paths in a desperate search for a sense of home and security.
items.title: Three Blue Boats

items.overview: Turkey's shimmering Tuz Lake, the country's second-largest lake, supplies 70% of its salt, even as its waters recede due to climate change. Here villagers still harvest pure, untreated salt. For widower Salih, salt is more than a livelihood – it's survival. Before dawn, he rides out on his loyal horse Fedai with his daughter Zeliş, gathering salt at sunrise and sharing the harvest with neighbours. But when Salih's friend Muhtar yields to the mayor's orders and a greedy corporation claims the lake's salt rights, villagers are barred from the shore and threatened with losing their horses. Salih refuses to give in. He makes forbidden journeys, devises schemes to outwit the ever-watchful gendarmes, and relies on his honest heart and loyal accomplices.
items.title: White as Salt

items.overview: Marooned by time and place in a natural world untouched by humankind, a refugee mother and her young son live alone in a mysterious sphere. The boy has never seen another human and fearing the inevitable solitude of outliving his mother, he refuses to believe they are alone.
items.title: I Am Not The Last

items.original_title: فقز میخوام با مامانم حرف بزنم
items.overview: An Iranian actress living in Istanbul tries to reach her mother in Iran during the recent events in Iran, marked by conflict, political tensions, and internet shutdowns. As communication lines collapse, she finds herself trapped between fear, uncertainty, and the painful distance separating her from the person she loves most. A personal journey about family, borders, and the universal human need to be heard.
items.title: I Just Want to Talk to My Mom

items.overview: Halima underwent an operation to reconstruct her vulva after female genital mutilation. On her journey home, she talks about her way of staying strong. A film about the consequences of FGM, everyday racism in Germany and reality as a female refugee.  Halima is a collective figure, representing biography, struggle and point of view of five somali women, who had suffred from FGM/C and worked on the film in all stages of production.
items.title: Halima - How to Stay Strong

items.overview: An intimate double portrait of two young men from Ivory Coast who fled to Europe together. Kader now has legal residency in Italy, while Inza is undocumented in France. For both, the gap between expectation and reality proves almost impossible to bridge.
items.title: Lonan Tché

items.overview: After falling short of his athletic dreams, a once-promising Ugandan runner rediscovers purpose - using the power of sport to rebuild his broken community and to honour his trainer’s life.
items.title: Miles of Life

items.overview: Floating around the city after breaking up with her girlfriend, Ekim, a young actor,  meets Beril at a dinner party. They decide to leave.
items.title: Smoke Suggests Fire

items.overview: Two strangers leave a club to look for a place to pee. A childhood game echoes through the streets. While deciding who will be “it,” they realize the game has already begun, long enough to forget why they went out in the first place.
items.title: Above the Ground

items.overview: Claire Bennett is a successful business consultant in Manhattan who unexpectedly inherits her beloved Uncle Lou's Christmas-themed bar, The Tipsy Reindeer, in upstate New York. When she returns, Claire discovers the bar comes with high debt – her Uncle Lou was overly generous to people in town while the booming business of Algorithm, an upscale and trendy new club, added insult to injury. She intends to turn things around before Christmas and sell to someone who will preserve her uncle's legacy and then return to her life in the city. Claire meets Zach, Algorithm's part owner and manager, who tells her they want to buy The Tipsy Reindeer so they can expand. Claire bristles at the proposition and they agree to face off in a 12 Days of Christmas-inspired series of festive events to see who can bring in the most business. If Claire wins, Zach will use his contacts to find the right buyer, but if Zach emerges victorious, Claire agrees to consider Algorithm's offer.
items.title: Mistletoe and Mimosas

items.overview: When Leila is dispatched to deliver blood for a patient suffering from a gunshot wound, the mission begins to mirror her own trauma. The past and present collapse into each other and her urgency becomes charged with survivor’s guilt and the fear of another irreversible loss.
items.title: Blood Runner

items.original_title: Toen Ik Klein Was, Was Ik Niet Bang
items.overview: In the buzzing chaos of Rotterdam-IJsselmonde, 10-year-old Gush runs into a strange neighbor: a future version of himself, lost in stories that might just change everything.
items.title: When I Was Little, I Wasn't Afraid

items.overview: A woman is interviewed for a job.
items.title: Regret to Inform You

items.overview: When a widowed birdwatcher reluctantly teams up with her granddaughter for a local birdwatching competition on an island in Scotland, their search for rare species becomes a heartfelt journey through grief, love, and letting go.
items.title: Beautiful Birds

items.overview: Four friends have their interpersonal and professional lives fall apart across a day of smoking weed.
items.title: The Bleeders

items.overview: A young man finally finds his soulmate: himself. After all, no one understands him as well. The two of them could live forever in their comfort zone -- if only it weren't for that one little thing.
items.title: Selflove

results.overview: An American expat’s first-day commute on Berlin’s Ringbahn becomes a loop that will not stop. Its enforcers demand a fare; his ticket and credentials mean nothing. The machine wants the one thing he refuses to give.

results.overview: In a remote village, a determined teenage boy named Asho makes a brave decision and takes a two-year-old girl named Asma to another village so her arrival may bring blessing. On the way, an unexpected event forces Asho to choose between returning Asma and following his own need.
results.title: Wolf's Hair

results.overview: A documentary set in Gatineau, Québec, following a group of teenage friends who gather for an underground fight club in a garage. Through an evening of boxing matches, the film explores the dynamics of friendship, rivalry and camaraderie among the group.
results.title: No Cheap Shots

results.overview: In a remote village, a determined teenage boy named Asho makes a brave decision and takes a two-year-old girl named Asma to another village so her arrival may bring blessing. On the way, an unexpected event forces Asho to choose between returning Asma and following his own need.
results.title: Wolf's Hair

results.overview: A documentary set in Gatineau, Québec, following a group of teenage friends who gather for an underground fight club in a garage. Through an evening of boxing matches, the film explores the dynamics of friendship, rivalry and camaraderie among the group.
results.title: No Cheap Shots

results.overview: It’s a 100-minute drama. We’re not sharing the title or synopsis yet.
results.title: KIRAC 32

results.overview: Herbert, a middle-aged investment banker, secretly spends his lunch breaks learning to skateboard after a group of local skaters take him in. However, when a coworker finds out, he must decide what scares him more: judgment or regret.
results.title: Don’t Bail

results.overview: Join Dan and many other friendly faces from across Austin, TX, as they perform multiple pain-inducing stunts and gags  to commemorate Dan's 26th birthday including; The Uni-Bastard, The Blind Butt Tattoo, and Baby Oil Couch Surfing.
results.title: danass

results.overview: An ordinary night turns into a living nightmare when a 14-year-old boy hears a sharp tap on his bedroom window.  Outside in the freezing air stands a breathless stranger, desperately running from the police. With sirens wailing in the distance, a terrifying standoff begins through the glass. Safe inside but completely isolated, the boy faces an impossible, split-second choice that will instantly shatter the security of his home.
results.title: Who Are You?

results.overview: When an unexpected event shatters a 10-year-old girl’s mental state, her hyper-precise daily ritual of cooking sour soup for her sick mother completely breaks down, leaving her with a ruined recipe she can no longer fix.
results.title: Sinigang na Tuyo (Dried Pork Stew)

results.overview: A young Deaf artist struggling to connect with her mother finds an unexpected bridge through friendship, art, and Filipino Sign Language, forcing her to confront their widening distance.
results.title: Patlang (Gap)

results.overview: Max, a blind Zapotec accordion player, and Sam, a British violinist who speaks "poquito" Spanish, meet on the streets of Oaxaca City. There a friendship is born that transcends language, culture, music, and the senses.
results.title: Zapocelta

results.original_title: Antisémitisme, une haine toujours en mouvements
results.title: Antisémitisme, une haine toujours en mouvements

results.overview: The film bears a joint Egyptian-German character, and through its title and artistic journey, it provides a space to celebrate one of the most prominent figures of Arab music, composer Mohamed Abdel Wahab, and to explore his musical legacy and influence, with the participation of Fatma Said, who is considered one of the most prominent Egyptian voices in the world of opera and classical singing globally blending cinematic and musical language.
results.title: Fatma Said and the Abdelwahab Plan

results.overview: A theatre critic interviews the first AI to have an original play open on Broadway.
results.title: _Preview_

results.overview: A short film produced by the 2nd Unit Class at SZFE.
results.title: Exit

results.overview: Inspired by real events where the heroic act of pedestrians saved a man from his cousin, who attacked him with a knife attack due to an argument about inheritance.
results.title: Unspoken Worlds

results.overview: Augusta Street, São Paulo, near future. Amid neon and underpaid gigs claimed by robots and cyborgs, a lonely android wanders in search of a pleasure it may never have been programmed to feel.
results.title: Augusta 2049: A Street Named Sin

results.overview: A lonely British-Chinese girl is excited to finally make a new friend when her new neighbours move in, but soon comes to realise that the world is never so simple…
results.title: Chilli Chong Carne

results.overview: A group of Jewish Ramblers from Manchester find solace, friendship and tranquility in the spectacular hills around the city.
results.title: Rambling

results.original_title: Rachel Jones Needs a Boyfriend Not a Bat-Mitzvah
results.overview: Follows a young Welsh Jewish girl on her quest for a boyfriend, while also trying to prepare for her upcoming Bat Mitzvah.
results.title: Rachel Jones Needs a Boyfriend Not a Bat-Mitzvah

results.overview: What if life gave you a second chance? The sea might grant you a second life, but it doesn’t teach you what to do with it.  After surviving a shipwreck in the middle of the Atlantic as a young sailor, a man carries an impossible question for decades: what should he do with the time he was never meant to have?  Through memories, silences, and a relationship shaped by the sea, *Borrowed Time* is an intimate reflection on the fragility of existence, the weight of memory, and the human need to find meaning in second chances.
results.title: Tiempo Prestado

results.overview: As he is about to leave Viña del Mar, his hometown, Javier begins filming gardens without quite knowing what he is looking for. For eight years, each time he returns, he explores trees, plants, and landscapes, composing a visual essay in which avocado trees, palm trees, and roses coexist with fairy tales, colonial ghosts, and the class conflicts that run through the heart of his own family.
results.title: Ciudad Jardín

results.overview: While trying to explain to her seven-year-old son what it was like to grow up in Chile under the civil-military dictatorship, a mother is confronted with her own memories and the need to revisit her past.  After almost twenty years living in Spain, she decides to find women who, like her, were born and spent their early years under the Chilean dictatorship. Andrea, Claudia, Alejandra, Daniela, Victoria and Sol gather in a house to share their experiences and explore how that early experience — often fragmented or beyond conscious memory — has left marks that remain present in their lives.  In this encounter, the personal and the political intertwine, giving rise to a collective reflection on memory, identity, and the ways in which the past transforms and endures from one generation to another.
results.title: Not All The Girls

results.overview: Different ages, situations and languages converge seemingly at random on the same mat: one person practices prenatal exercises, another takes contortion lessons, and another prays with disciplined devotion.  Gradually, through drawings, glances, flowers and somersaults, gestures and connections begin to emerge, hinting at a bond between them. Around the mat, a slow process of bodily self-deformation unfolds, where destruction and creation become indistinguishable, and care and pain intertwine.
results.title: (de)forma

results.overview: Two realities slowly align as Fang's chaos magic targeting pop star Eileen Rye triggers an unforeseen change. Fang seeks meaning in the mysterious thread they've pulled, both entering a world where memories, dreams, and digital encounters merge.
results.title: Octarine

results.original_title: The Best Justice System in the World
results.overview: A humorous look at the not-so-funny ways the government and corporations strip us of our right to a jury trial
results.title: The Best Justice System in the World

results.overview: A junior footballer navigates the brutal hierarchy of a 1988 professional football club steeped in a culture of systemic bullying . His growing unease culminates in a hesitant act of defiance sparking a brutal backlash, turning the violence directly onto him.
results.title: The Boot Room

results.overview: The architect of a virtual world called Presence is interviewed about its profound capabilities – it can trigger lucidity in Alzheimer's patients. Meanwhile, inside Presence, a daughter tries to reconnect with her mother, an Alzheimer's sufferer, and bring her back to the physical world.
results.title: The Phenomenon of Presence

results.overview: Mizoram unfolds as a land where mist-covered hills, close-knit tribes, and an enduring spirit of community shape every aspect of life. This documentary journeys into the heart of Mizo society, exploring the guiding ethos of tlawmngaihna—the tradition of selflessness, courage, discipline, and service to others.
results.title: Ethos of Mizoram

results.overview: In a dark factory, a bullying worker pushes his crew of robots harder and harder. They observe. They learn. And eventually, they act. The machines are learning, but what are we teaching them?
results.title: Machines Learning

results.overview: Clotaire Poirier is not your typical chef. A globetrotter and polyglot, he rose to prominence with French audiences as a finalist on "Top Chef", embodying a new generation of cooks for whom performance no longer comes at the expense of people.
results.title: Don't Call Me Chef

results.overview: A film about a mind-numbing job, delicious food, absurd numbers, big dreams, death, and toast.
results.title: The Toast Trip

results.overview: May and Sultan struggle to live within a home consumed by silence after a devastating loss alters their relationship forever. While Sultan clings to hope and the possibility of moving forward, May endures relentless physical pain and carries a secret she cannot bring herself to reveal. As the distance between them grows, old suspicions resurface, and the burden she bears begins to fracture the fragile foundation of their marriage.
results.title: What We Carry

results.overview: Edgar draws dancers in Amsterdam. Everyone knows him.
results.title: The One Who Draws Dance

results.overview: A forty-year-old woman floats in a relationship bubble until she realizes it is too late.
results.title: Bubbles

results.overview: A young girl watches an old dog. Taking the dog on a walk, a rough encounter with a bully has dire consequences.
results.title: Fido

results.overview: Thian 'Tarzan' de Vries is a young kickboxing sensation from the Netherlands who is rapidly conquering the international fight scene. Behind his invincible image, however, lies a turbulent past marked by addiction, crime, and time spent in youth detention. Kickboxing became both his escape and his salvation. As Thian rises through the ranks toward global recognition, an unease grows beneath the surface: can he keep control when the system that protects him begins to crack?
results.title: Knocked Cold

results.overview: Two former coworkers lose their insurance and decide couples therapy is a budget-friendly option
results.title: Friends With Benefits

results.overview: Ignored by history for 40 years, the Oversteegen sisters' true story inspires "Murderers" (1941-1990). Two teenage girls lure a Nazi to his death. Echoing the psychological trauma of war, emigration, and today's chilling winds of fascism, the film asks: what is the true price of murder for a righteous cause, and what remains of our humanity after we are forced to cross the ultimate line?
results.title: Murderers

results.overview: In a wasteland of rubble and ruin, J. Doe—a Black Patient Zero—navigates the wreckage of a nation haunted by its own reflection. Pursued by histories of violence, erasure, and resistance, he confronts the ghosts of an unfinished reckoning. Blurring archive and hallucination, Disordered is a visual requiem—part ritual, part rupture—that confronts the consequences of a soul that cannot forget, yet refuses to remember its past.
results.title: D!SoRd3rEd

results.overview: A very important company audit is jeopardized when a staff member reveals the fates of his coworkers' eternal souls.
results.title: The Audit

results.overview: At 89, Joseph Ullmann keeps the tradition of his grandfather’s Budapest antique jewellery business alive. In today’s Hatton Garden, he and his shop are the last of their kind.
results.title: The Last Jewel

results.overview: A fairy tale about an animated film. The life of this film suddenly takes a cursed turn. The consequences of this change become apparent
results.title: Frame Story

results.overview: The quest for a lost cyberpunk book written in the 1990s by Pepe Rojo, rumored to be a prophetic work of its time. After uncovering new leads, an obsessed young man embarks on a journey across northern Mexico to track down the remaining fragments and fuel his own delusion.
results.title: Al Tiempo le da Hipo

results.overview: As a strange red lichen spreads across the countryside, Geryon confronts the emergence of sexual desire and an animal metamorphosis that drives him to flee into the mountains.
results.title: Grace Comes Crashing

results.overview: On her birthday, Kiran, an overworked mother, is faced with a fantastical possibility when her yesteryear Bollywood crush arrives at her door, with just one request - to marry her.
results.title: Dream Girl

results.overview: Egos, money and science intersect in this modern American parable that follows the king of the dinosaurs and those who unearth its remains. Paleontologist Dr. Thomas Carr hopes his latest find, a juvenile T. rex, can keep his crucial research alive as he navigates the crumbling world of academia and relentless funding pressure. Meanwhile, commercial fossil hunter Alan Detrich leads multimillion-dollar dinosaur auctions and teams up with a Kansas museum to show off a T. rex specimen so rare it could change the face of prehistory. As these two titans of paleontology clash, we are confronted with two paths for the future of science: raw capitalism or putting collective knowledge before the pursuit of profit.
results.title: The New Extinction

results.overview: Linda is a widow raising her seven-year-old son alone. The boy suffers from xeroderma pigmentosum, a rare genetic disorder. He will suffer severe damage once exposed to sunlight and has to stay in the shadows for most of his life. To protect her son, Linda builds layers of barriers to shut out the outside world. As time goes by, the mother gradually realises that overprotection will only deprive her child of the right to experience life.
results.title: To The Sun and Beyond

results.overview: During their holiday, two little girls help Janet, a heartbroken English traveller—unaware that this encounter will jeopardise their own family
results.title: Janet's Island

results.overview: Dustin and Dibz are best pals; they survived their senior year of college, and their future looks bright. They share an apartment, an internet series, and the dream of finding their place in an uncertain landscape, navigating male fragility and identity crisis. The challenges of messy adult manhood are fully open to them.
results.title: Pop Pop

results.overview: In a remote village, two rival families – one privileged Hindu, the other a struggling Muslim family – are trapped in an endless cycle of feuds. A young man dreaming of TikTok fame and a woman yearning to escape patriarchy fall in love. When an inheritance dispute erupts, their relationship is caught between greed, betrayal, and a conflict that threatens to turn blood against blood.
results.title: Kidney

results.overview: Guided by a prophetic dream, Gift travels through Niger, Algeria, and Tunisia on her way to Europe. This poetic film follows her struggle to stand on her own two feet and shows the personal cost of her dangerous search for a better life.
results.title: You Don't Die Two Times

results.overview: In a chalet in the Ukrainian mountains, four women attend therapy sessions to recover from their very different, deeply traumatic experiences of the war. They each try, in their own way, to resume their former lives.
results.title: Women and War

results.overview: Following the final voyage of the enormous, ageing cruise ship Royal Splendor through the Three Gorges on the Yangtze, this experimental film explores the river as a living repository of memory.
results.title: Waves of Time

results.overview: Four years in the life of Zaira, an elderly woman living in the marshlands of Iraq. Against all odds, she clings to her life close to nature. A poetic and moving testament to resilience and perseverance.
results.title: She Was Not Alone

results.overview: Long, observational shots of people and animals going about their activities in the landscape surrounding a gigantic, ever-growing landfill site prompt reflection on the traces we as humans leave behind on our planet.
results.title: Radiant Mountain

results.overview: As the granddaughter of a Roma king, ten-year-old Nicoleta seems destined for a fairy-tale life. She will marry young and live in a palace. But looking at her grandmother, mother, and aunt, she also sees a traditional life constrained by patriarchy.
results.title: A Modern Roma Fairytale

results.overview: In a small square in Mexico City, Haitian migrants live in a makeshift tent camp. This observational film follows three women whose daily life finds its own rhythm, despite the instability.
results.title: Here Where the Fire Burns

results.overview: A major earthquake will occur along the San Andreas Fault in California sometime—that much is certain. But when? A free-associative road trip with mineral meditations about life on the edge, where tectonic plates collide.
results.title: Drop! Cover! Hold On!

results.overview: Ruslan Fedotov follows the course of the Dnieper to observe the lives of young people in Russia and Belarus, tracing how collective memory enters the lives and imagination of youth.
results.title: Down the River

results.overview: A portrait of painter Peter Dumas, the father of photographer and filmmaker Charlotte Dumas, is interwoven with observations of her daughter Ivy as she grows up. The creative process connects their lives.
results.title: The Brush in Your Hand

results.overview: In Berlin, a diverse coalition of activists joins forces to speak out against the violence in Gaza and the German government’s support for it. Faced with arrests, possible deportations, and strict restrictions on protests, the activists seek ways to continue their struggle. In this climate, they start rehearsing a stage adaptation of a 1970s queer book entitled The Faggots and Their Friends Between Revolutions. This hybrid and experimental film shifts between rehearsals of the play and the everyday reality of activism. Passages from the play—about power structures, exclusion, and solidarity—are interwoven with their ongoing protests and their sometimes sympathetic, sometimes confrontational conversations with the press. Juxtaposed, the intensity of protest and the creative freedom of theater sharpen the focus on what it means to be an activist—and the toll it takes on those involved.
results.title: Between Revolutions

results.overview: Ruslan Fedotov follows the course of the Dnieper to observe the lives of young people in Russia and Belarus, tracing how collective memory enters the lives and imagination of youth.
results.title: Down the River

results.overview: A portrait of painter Peter Dumas, the father of photographer and filmmaker Charlotte Dumas, is interwoven with observations of her daughter Ivy as she grows up. The creative process connects their lives.
results.title: The Brush in Your Hand

results.title: Between Revolutions

results.overview: A recent grad spends her summer avoiding responsibility in an empty apartment, bumming around her small, southern college town with the maintenance man.
results.title: Baby Angel

results.overview: This film is a coming-of-age short drama set against the isolated, moody landscapes of Cornwall, England. It follows two young brothers who find themselves completely alone after their estranged father vanishes. Armed with only a few belongings, they wander through the backwaters and costal paths in a desperate search for a sense of home and security.
results.title: Three Blue Boats

results.overview: Turkey's shimmering Tuz Lake, the country's second-largest lake, supplies 70% of its salt, even as its waters recede due to climate change. Here villagers still harvest pure, untreated salt. For widower Salih, salt is more than a livelihood – it's survival. Before dawn, he rides out on his loyal horse Fedai with his daughter Zeliş, gathering salt at sunrise and sharing the harvest with neighbours. But when Salih's friend Muhtar yields to the mayor's orders and a greedy corporation claims the lake's salt rights, villagers are barred from the shore and threatened with losing their horses. Salih refuses to give in. He makes forbidden journeys, devises schemes to outwit the ever-watchful gendarmes, and relies on his honest heart and loyal accomplices.
results.title: White as Salt

results.overview: Marooned by time and place in a natural world untouched by humankind, a refugee mother and her young son live alone in a mysterious sphere. The boy has never seen another human and fearing the inevitable solitude of outliving his mother, he refuses to believe they are alone.
results.title: I Am Not The Last

results.original_title: فقز میخوام با مامانم حرف بزنم
results.overview: An Iranian actress living in Istanbul tries to reach her mother in Iran during the recent events in Iran, marked by conflict, political tensions, and internet shutdowns. As communication lines collapse, she finds herself trapped between fear, uncertainty, and the painful distance separating her from the person she loves most. A personal journey about family, borders, and the universal human need to be heard.
results.title: I Just Want to Talk to My Mom

results.overview: Halima underwent an operation to reconstruct her vulva after female genital mutilation. On her journey home, she talks about her way of staying strong. A film about the consequences of FGM, everyday racism in Germany and reality as a female refugee.  Halima is a collective figure, representing biography, struggle and point of view of five somali women, who had suffred from FGM/C and worked on the film in all stages of production.
results.title: Halima - How to Stay Strong

results.overview: An intimate double portrait of two young men from Ivory Coast who fled to Europe together. Kader now has legal residency in Italy, while Inza is undocumented in France. For both, the gap between expectation and reality proves almost impossible to bridge.
results.title: Lonan Tché

results.overview: After falling short of his athletic dreams, a once-promising Ugandan runner rediscovers purpose - using the power of sport to rebuild his broken community and to honour his trainer’s life.
results.title: Miles of Life

results.overview: Floating around the city after breaking up with her girlfriend, Ekim, a young actor,  meets Beril at a dinner party. They decide to leave.
results.title: Smoke Suggests Fire

results.overview: Two strangers leave a club to look for a place to pee. A childhood game echoes through the streets. While deciding who will be “it,” they realize the game has already begun, long enough to forget why they went out in the first place.
results.title: Above the Ground

results.overview: Claire Bennett is a successful business consultant in Manhattan who unexpectedly inherits her beloved Uncle Lou's Christmas-themed bar, The Tipsy Reindeer, in upstate New York. When she returns, Claire discovers the bar comes with high debt – her Uncle Lou was overly generous to people in town while the booming business of Algorithm, an upscale and trendy new club, added insult to injury. She intends to turn things around before Christmas and sell to someone who will preserve her uncle's legacy and then return to her life in the city. Claire meets Zach, Algorithm's part owner and manager, who tells her they want to buy The Tipsy Reindeer so they can expand. Claire bristles at the proposition and they agree to face off in a 12 Days of Christmas-inspired series of festive events to see who can bring in the most business. If Claire wins, Zach will use his contacts to find the right buyer, but if Zach emerges victorious, Claire agrees to consider Algorithm's offer.
results.title: Mistletoe and Mimosas

results.overview: When Leila is dispatched to deliver blood for a patient suffering from a gunshot wound, the mission begins to mirror her own trauma. The past and present collapse into each other and her urgency becomes charged with survivor’s guilt and the fear of another irreversible loss.
results.title: Blood Runner

results.original_title: Toen Ik Klein Was, Was Ik Niet Bang
results.overview: In the buzzing chaos of Rotterdam-IJsselmonde, 10-year-old Gush runs into a strange neighbor: a future version of himself, lost in stories that might just change everything.
results.title: When I Was Little, I Wasn't Afraid

results.overview: A woman is interviewed for a job.
results.title: Regret to Inform You

results.overview: When a widowed birdwatcher reluctantly teams up with her granddaughter for a local birdwatching competition on an island in Scotland, their search for rare species becomes a heartfelt journey through grief, love, and letting go.
results.title: Beautiful Birds

results.overview: Four friends have their interpersonal and professional lives fall apart across a day of smoking weed.
results.title: The Bleeders

results.overview: A young man finally finds his soulmate: himself. After all, no one understands him as well. The two of them could live forever in their comfort zone -- if only it weren't for that one little thing.
results.title: Selflove
